text:
rachel.pm: Quick heads-up 75min7 playbook: Crestline (retail AI) agreed to a short case study. 20m interview + 1 signed quote. Need Qs, legal release, design, and lead routing.
theo.marketing: excellent. timezone note: their ML lead is PST, product PM is CET. Can we aim for Tue 10am PT / 19:00 CET?
nish.infra: Tue 10am PT works for me. Prefer recording off by default.
rachel.pm: can someone draft short Qs focused on benchmark + business outcome? we want a 1-line TL;DR for EU and one for JP audiences.
theo.marketing: I'll draft 7 Qs + 2 pull-quote prompts. short and measurable. sending in a few. :pencil2:

Draft Qs (theo.marketing):
1) short role + Crestline's feature using Redwood Inference
2) which model/workload did you benchmark? (please include job/run id if possible)
3) baseline vs current median latency (ms) and throughput change
4) config notes that mattered (batching, KV cache, quantization)
5) measurable business outcome (conversion, throughput, ops hours)
6) can you provide a one-line quote confirming the 2.8x latency improvement? include signoff name/email
7) any legal/compliance constraints or embargo windows?
Pull-quote prompts: "one-sentence impact" and "metric + signoff (name, title)"

nish.infra: legal will need either raw run artifacts (config + logs + job id) or a signed attestation. tagging legal-team.
legal-team: confirmed 1) for numeric claims we need artifacts or attestation; 2) quote release signed within 72h after we send the form; 3) no PII/screenshots unless redacted.
legal-team: we'll prep a compact quote release template and an attestation form after the call.
ops-bot: (automated) provisional calendar created: Tue 2026-05-19 10:00 PT 	invite pending acceptance. Recording disabled by default.
theo.marketing: also asking Crestline if they can provide the job id and a short methodology blurb we can cite. if we only get attestation, we'll label metrics as "customer-reported" and include the attestation.
rachel.pm: webinar ask: can Crestline join a 15m launch panel in week-of publish? ask for an eng speaker and a 3-slide summary.
design-squad: once quote is signed please produce hero + two social cards (16:9 and 1:1) and a short animated banner for the site. target delivery 48h after signoff.
theo.marketing: localization: need TL;DR for EU (EN), a German headline, and a Japanese short caption for socials. Crestline has EU ops and JP customers.
sam.ae: routing: route inbound leads from the case page to AE-Midwest (ae-mid) and tag "priority:enterprise". set lead score to 88 for sales nurture.
rachel.pm: timeline proposal: interview Tue, quote release signed by Fri (72h), legal signoff Fri evening, design comps Mon, publish Thu, panel the following Tue. tight but doable.
legal-team: quick reminder  attach either run artifacts or signed attestation to the signed release. otherwise we can't approve numeric callouts.
theo.marketing: noted. i'll include an explicit request in the Qs: "Please attach job/run id and config or sign the attestation."
ops-bot: (automated) checklist created and pinned: interview asset, quote signed, artifacts/attestation, headshot, logo SVG, localized TL;DRs, design assets, routing tags, embargo date.
rachel.pm: setting embargo to publish day 00:00 UTC. treat as confidential until then.
theo.marketing: sending the Qs + release link to Crestline now. will post reply here.
design-squad: small ask 	please pre-prepare a hero template that fits both EN/DE/JP captions so we can swap text quickly.
design-squad: got it. will prep responsive templates and request Crestline logo SVG + headshot after the call.
rachel.pm: last note 	if Crestline only provides attestation we will use wording: "based on customer-reported benchmark (attestation on file)."
sam.ae: will update playbook with the routing rule and nurture steps after publish.
rachel.pm: thanks everyone. i'll update thread after Crestline responds. :sparkles:
